sum: BlossomHill Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, develops small molecule medicines that address medical needs in cancer treatment. Its pipeline includes BH-30643, an OMNI-EGFR inhibitor in clinical development for advanced EGFR-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), BH-501284, and BH-30236, a macrocyclic CLK (Cdc2-like kinase) inhibitor being evaluated in patients with relapsed or refractory acute myeloid leukemia (R/R AML) and higher-risk myelodysplastic syndrome (HR-MDS). BlossomHill Therapeutics, Inc. was incorporated in 2020 and is based in San Diego, California.
ceo: Dr. Jingrong  Jean Cui Ph.D. (Scientific Founder, President, CEO & Director)
